content.thinking: The spike begins at 22:19, with pricing.io-internal.svc jumping to 1500ms on basket-total calls across p50/p95/p99. Since io-pricing is internal and owned by the same org (checkout-platform), this points clearly to an internal-dependency-failure with io-pricing as the faulting service, and no deployment changes were recorded — I'm confident in this diagnosis.

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's account page renders call pricing.io-internal.svc (io-pricing) for basket-total; starting at 22:19:00Z that call began taking ~1500ms per request for nearly all requests, which lines up exactly with the p50/p95/p99 latency jump from ~45ms/215ms/380ms to ~1540ms/1710ms/1880ms in the metrics. io-pricing is an internal service owned by the same organisation (checkout-platform), so this is an internal dependency slowing down and dragging io-shop's latency with it, with no code or config change on io-shop itself.
